about: Pinned inputs of the PS5Cemu build. `make deps` (tools/deps.py) fetches every missing item and leaves existing checkouts and files untouched. Paths are relative to the repository root.

items.name: cemu
items.about: Cemu (Wii U emulator) at the pinned upstream commit, with the submodules the PS5 build uses

items.name: boilerplate
items.about: PS5 Native App Boilerplate (BlackBearReloaded's, from drakmor's copy since the original went with its account): public Payload SDK v0.42, the runtime libc.prx shim and the native packaging tool

items.name: pacbrew
items.about: Prebuilt PS5 libraries from pacbrew v0.40.2: curl, OpenSSL, zlib, zstd, libpng, glm, fmt 12.1, FreeType, RmlUi 6.2, SDL2 (the launcher's video) and libiconv

items.name: boost
items.about: Boost 1.90.0 (filesystem, program_options, nowide built for the PS5; the rest header-only)

items.name: pugixml
items.about: pugixml 1.15

items.name: libzip
items.about: libzip 1.11.4

items.name: glslang
items.about: glslang 15.1.0, the version Cemu's vcpkg manifest pins

items.name: rapidjson
items.about: RapidJSON (header-only)

items.name: ps5-mesa
items.about: Mihawk-99's Mesa 26.2 fork: RADV with the PS5 winsys and the VideoOut swapchain, at the revision PS5_Vulkan pins (tools/build-radv.sh builds it with PS5_Vulkan's recipe)

items.name: ps5-vulkan
items.about: Mihawk-99's PS5_Vulkan: RADV's build and link recipe for titles (tools/build-radv.sh, tools/radv-link.sh), its linker script and the AGC link stubs

items.name: ps5-payload-sdk-fork
items.about: Mihawk-99's payload SDK fork with the PS5 platform layer RADV's winsys is built on, at the revision PS5_Vulkan pins

items.name: azahar
items.about: Mihawk-99's PS5_Azahar: Azahar (3DS emulator, GPL-2.0-or-later) with PS5_Dynarmic, whose code cache is the console's executable memory. patches/azahar holds the port's changes (tools/azahar-patches.sh); tools/build-azahar.sh builds its core. A new pin can change what a save state holds: then raise ps5_state_format in src/core/savestate.cpp (patch 0011), or earlier builds' states load into it

items.name: melonds
items.about: melonDS 1.1 (Nintendo DS emulator, GPL-3.0-or-later), the core of the 3DS side's DS games. patches/melonds holds the port's changes (tools/melonds-patches.sh): its JIT's code in the console's executable direct memory, no fast memory; tools/build-melonds.sh builds its core with the port's frontend (port/melonds)

items.name: compiler-rt
items.about: LLVM 18.1.8 builtins Clang's PS5 code calls and the host has no compiler-rt for: the emulated-TLS runtime (emutls.c, for -femulated-tls) and __cpu_model (x86.c, for __builtin_cpu_supports in RADV)

items.name: reshade
items.about: ReShade 6.8.0 (BSD-3-Clause): its effect compiler (ReShade FX to SPIR-V), with the SPIR-V headers and stb's image loaders it builds with. port/cemu/ReShadeEffects.cpp compiles effects with it and port/cemu/ReShadeRuntime.cpp runs them

items.name: prosperoedenx
items.about: ProsperoEdenX, premohq's fork of Sword's ProsperoEden (GPL-3.0-or-later): Eden, the Switch emulator, for the PS5, with its launcher and every feature of its own. patches/eden holds the port's changes (tools/eden-patches.sh), Takoroka's eden-nx2 as its Eden among them (0021: Switch 2 games, experimental): it lives in the app's eden/ and keeps its data in /data/eden, with legacy discovery under /data/ps5cemu/eden, and it goes back to PS5-ECAM when its game ends. tools/build-eden.sh builds it with its own Makefile, which fetches its inputs at their pins beside it

items.name: mihawkgen
items.about: Mihawk-99's PS5_MihawkGen (framegen/ GPL-3.0-or-later): neural frame generation in compute shaders, the picture between two frames from their colour alone. Frame generation on the Wii U and 3DS sides (port/cemu/FrameGenPS5.cpp, patches/cemu 0042 and patches/azahar 0033) records it as a picture is presented, with the network.fgw the app's eden/mihawkgen carries

items.name: rcheevos
items.about: rcheevos 12.5.0 (MIT), RetroAchievements' client library: DS games' achievements (port/app/achievements.cpp), built by port/CMakeLists.txt

items.name: dr_mp3
items.about: dr_mp3 v0.7.3 (public domain or MIT-0): the MP3 decoder for the launcher's music from /data/ps5cemu/music (port/frontend/sound.cpp)

items.name: forwarder-format
items.about: The PS5 Forwarder Format (GPL-3.0-or-later): psfwd, the library that writes a game's home screen tile (port/app/forwarders.cpp), and the tile program the tiles run (template/, packaged as assets/forwarder)

items.name: libretro-common
items.about: libretro-common (MIT): the helpers a libretro core built for a static frontend leaves to it, one copy for every core (tools/build-libretro.py)

items.name: libretro-mesen
items.about: Mesen's libretro core (GPL-3.0): the NES and the Famicom Disk System (tools/build-libretro.py)

items.name: libretro-mesen-s
items.about: Mesen-S's libretro core (GPL-3.0): the SNES, Satellaview and Sufami Turbo (tools/build-libretro.py)

items.name: libretro-mgba
items.about: mGBA's libretro core (MPL-2.0): the Game Boy, the Game Boy Color and the Game Boy Advance (tools/build-libretro.py)

items.name: libretro-beetle-vb
items.about: Beetle VB, Mednafen's Virtual Boy as a libretro core (GPL-2.0-or-later) (tools/build-libretro.py)

items.name: libretro-pokemini
items.about: PokeMini's libretro core (GPL-3.0-or-later): the Pokémon mini (tools/build-libretro.py)

items.name: ps5-retroarch
items.about: Mihawk-99's PS5 RetroArch (GPL-3.0-or-later): its EmulationStation (ES-DE 3.5.0) port, frontends/es-de, and the scripts that build ES-DE and its libraries for the PS5. tools/build-esde.sh builds it with PS5-ECAM's glue (port/esde/ps5) in place of RetroArch's, for Settings > Launcher > Start in EmulationStation

items.name: ps5-opengl
items.about: BlackBearReloaded's PS5 OpenGL 1.0.2 (GPL-3.0-or-later), darkxex's copy: the OpenGL 4.6 SDK and the SDL2 bridge EmulationStation draws through (tools/build-esde.sh)

items.name: sdl-ps5
items.about: ps5-payload-dev's SDL 2.30.12 fork (zlib), at the commit ps5-opengl's SDL2 bridge is built over (its integration/SDL2/README.md), for EmulationStation (tools/build-esde.sh)
